## Problem

What is missing or painful today? Who does it affect?

## Proposed solution

What should Cictus do? A short description of the behaviour you want.

## Alternatives considered

Other ways this could be solved, or workarounds you use today.

## Additional context

Links, screenshots, examples from other tools — anything that helps.
